# Generated by continuous-delivery-services-section/generator.
name: sync
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 6 * * *'
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [section-advanced]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/sync.yml']
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
concurrency:
  group: submodule-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  advance:
    uses: red-cup-engineering/continuous-delivery-services-section/.github/workflows/superrepo-advance.yml@07b3abdc21ede3cd6c4d7ffc9984b33f0d9af778
    with:
      source: ${{ github.event.client_payload.repository }}
      runs-on: "[\"self-hosted\",\"Linux\",\"X64\",\"bare-cedar-fog\"]"
    secrets:
      token: ${{ secrets.LMT_SUBMODULE_PAT }}

name: superrepo-advance
# Upward chain, parent side (requirement 20). Call it from a workflow triggered by
# repository_dispatch (type section-advanced) and a daily schedule. It is
# submodule-advance with the moved section named in the pull request.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: 'owner/repo that dispatched (github.event.client_payload.repository); empty on a schedule'
        type: string
        default: ''
      runs-on:
        type: string
        default: '["ubuntu-latest"]'
    secrets:
      token:
        required: false
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  advance:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/submodule-advance.yml
    with:
      note: ${{ inputs.source && format('Triggered by a push to main of {0}.', inputs.source) || 'Scheduled advance.' }}
      runs-on: ${{ inputs.runs-on }}
    secrets:
      token: ${{ secrets.token }}

name: submodule-advance
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      branch:
        description: 'PR branch name'
        type: string
        default: ci/submodule-advance
      note:
        description: 'line placed first in the pull request body (the upward chain names the section that moved)'
        type: string
        default: ''
      runs-on:
        description: 'JSON runner labels supplied by the hiring repository'
        type: string
        default: '["ubuntu-latest"]'
    secrets:
      token:
        description: 'PAT able to read submodule remotes and push/open PRs in the caller (falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN)'
        required: false
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  advance:
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.runs-on) }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.token || github.token }}
      BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
      NOTE: ${{ inputs.note }}
      BASE: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.token || github.token }}
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: red-cup-engineering/continuous-delivery-services-section
          ref: 33b3bf3564b04f2cb69bfc26466bcbcd9130a418
          path: .cds
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: keep the engine checkout out of the tree
        run: echo "/.cds" >> .git/info/exclude
      - name: advance gitlinks where the remote head moved
        id: advance
        run: node .cds/scripts/advance.mjs --branch "$BRANCH" --note "$NOTE"
      - name: open or update the one pull request
        if: always() && steps.advance.outputs.advanced == 'true'
        run: |
          set -eu
          if n=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number') && [ -n "$n" ]; then
            gh pr edit "$n" --body-file .git/advance-body.md
          else
            gh pr create --base "$BASE" --head "$BRANCH" --title "Advance submodules" --body-file .git/advance-body.md
          fi

name: GitHub Guix machine release
# Bare Cedar Fog is the integrated Group development workspace and MetroPlat host.
# Its machine definition is scoped inside that workspace. Publication builds only;
# deployment remains an explicit governed action while the host is held.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [build, deploy, check-failure, rollback]
        default: build
concurrency:
  group: bare-cedar-fog-guix-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || 'production' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, guix, bare-cedar-fog]
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      MACHINE_SOURCE_DIRECTORY: lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/561-group-services-section/services/561-group-operations-services-section/services/bare-cedar-fog-services-section/data/records/machine-deployment-service-records/metroplat
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/561-group-services-section/services/561-group-operations-services-section/services/bare-cedar-fog-services-section/data/records/machine-deployment-service-records/metroplat
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      # The runner's workspace is shared with the pull-request checks, which check out submodules at their
      # own pins; a later pin change leaves those gitlinks dirty and the deploy refuses the snapshot. The
      # release clones its pinned sources itself and reads no submodule, so it releases them first.
      - name: Release submodule checkouts left by other workflows
        run: git submodule status | awk '$1 !~ /^-/ {print $2}' | xargs -r git submodule deinit --force --
      - name: Build and receive the exact MetroPlat deployment definition
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=768
          RELEASE_MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'build' || inputs.mode || 'build' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/561-group"
          exec 9>"$HOME/.cache/561-group/github-guix-build.lease"
          flock --exclusive 9
          export GITHUB_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          # Controller bootstrap (projected from guix-machine-release-service scripts/controller-bootstrap.sh).
          # Resolve the release controller from the machine repository's own gitlink and fetch exactly the commit it records.
          # Shell and git only: the machine repository mounts the controller once, at its root.
          controller_repository=red-cup-engineering/guix-machine-release-service
          controller_top="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
          controller_names="$(git -C "$controller_top" config -f .gitmodules --get-regexp "^submodule\\..*\\.url$" | awk -v a="https://github.com/$controller_repository.git" -v b="https://github.com/$controller_repository" "\$2==a || \$2==b {sub(/^submodule\\./, \"\", \$1); sub(/\\.url$/, \"\", \$1); print \$1}")"
          [ "$(printf "%s" "$controller_names" | grep -c .)" = 1 ] || { echo "the machine repository must mount the release controller exactly once" >&2; exit 1; }
          controller_mount="$(git -C "$controller_top" config -f .gitmodules --get "submodule.$controller_names.path")"
          controller_commit="$(git -C "$controller_top" ls-tree HEAD -- "$controller_mount" | awk "\$2==\"commit\" {print \$3}")"
          [[ "$controller_commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "release controller needs an exact commit" >&2; exit 1; }
          controller_path=.
          controller_git=(git -c credential.helper= -c 'credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential')
          controller_root="$HOME/.cache/561-group/github-source-bootstrap/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/$GITHUB_SHA/controller"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$controller_root")"
          [ -d "$controller_root/.git" ] || "${controller_git[@]}" clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout "https://github.com/$controller_repository.git" "$controller_root"
          "${controller_git[@]}" -C "$controller_root" fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$controller_commit"
          git -C "$controller_root" sparse-checkout disable
          git -C "$controller_root" checkout -q --detach "$controller_commit"
          service="$(realpath "$controller_root/$controller_path")"
          case "$service/" in "$(realpath "$controller_root")/"*) ;; *) echo 'release controller resolves outside its repository' >&2; exit 1;; esac
          grep -Eq '"name": *"@red-cup-engineering/guix-machine-release-service"' "$service/package.json" || { echo 'selected source is not the release controller package' >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "RELEASE_CONTROLLER=$service" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"; RELEASE_CONTROLLER="$service"
          # End controller bootstrap.
          guix shell node -- node "$service/scripts/prepare-build-swap.mjs" machine.json
          work="$HOME/.cache/561-group/github-bare-cedar-fog-runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          guix repl -- "$service/scripts/pinned-guix.scm" channels.scm shell guile guile-json node -- \
            guile --no-auto-compile "$service/scripts/github-machine-release.scm" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$MACHINE_SOURCE_DIRECTORY" "$work" "$RELEASE_MODE"
      - name: Record the outcome for repository readers
        if: always()
        env:
          JOB_OUTCOME: ${{ job.status }}
        run: |
          work="$HOME/.cache/561-group/github-bare-cedar-fog-runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          if [ -n "${RELEASE_CONTROLLER:-}" ]; then
            guix shell node -- node "$RELEASE_CONTROLLER/scripts/record-outcome.mjs" "$work"
          else
            echo "Machine snapshot: \`$GITHUB_SHA\`; the release controller was not resolved, so no outcome was recorded." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
